Metadata.title: Bright Way Dental Clinic
Metadata.description: A premium bilingual website foundation for Bright Way Dental Clinic.

Preview.intro: A warm, restrained visual system created for a modern private dental clinic — balancing clinical clarity with a more personal sense of care.
Preview.note: This is the approved design foundation preview. Homepage content begins in Milestone 02.
Preview.paletteBody: Cream and ivory carry the atmosphere. Deep navy gives structure and confidence without turning the experience into a traditional medical website.
Preview.typeTitle: Editorial elegance, made easy to read.
Preview.typeBody: Expressive serif headlines introduce warmth and distinction. A clean sans serif keeps navigation, details and calls to action precise.
Preview.bodySample: Clear communication and a calm environment are essential parts of a more thoughtful dental experience.
Preview.rhythmBody: Fine rules, generous space and careful hierarchy replace excessive cards, shadows and decorative medical graphics.
Preview.principleOneBody: Ivory surfaces, soft contrast and room for content to breathe.
Preview.principleTwoBody: One dominant booking action supported by quiet secondary links.
Preview.principleThreeBody: English and Arabic receive equal hierarchy, spacing and visual care.
Preview.detailTitle: Premium does not need to feel distant.
Preview.detailBody: The system pairs an elevated visual language with calm, human copy. It is designed to earn trust before asking the visitor to act.
